position_semantics: For zero-based position p, count is the number of exact forward events accepting at least p+1 draft tokens; survival_rate=count/forward_events.

interpretation.observed_campaign_delta: Aggregate Hydra27 late-depth survival is lower, with the gap widening after position 4; accepted drafts/event is 8.73 percent below Tail6.
interpretation.counterevidence_to_uniform_regression: Hydra27 is better at every measured depth on task 1, better through position 4 on task 2, and better through position 2 on task 3.
interpretation.trajectory_confound: The arms are free-running sampled agents. Task lengths and generated contexts differ materially, so aggregate and per-task deltas do not isolate topology causally.
interpretation.branch_selection_visibility: Canonical FR13_BRANCH_ACCEPT_DIAG=0 provides no accepted-branch ID trace. Drafter hit logs prove branch materialization and cache engagement but cannot identify which added branch was accepted.
interpretation.kernel_separation: Hydra27 GPU components are only 1.05 percent slower than Tail6 while accepted drafts/event is 8.73 percent lower. The full-step TPS difference in this campaign is therefore dominated by trajectory acceptance, not a large kernel-time regression.
interpretation.next_proof: A causal topology claim requires paired same-trajectory teacher forcing or canonical accepted-path logging; neither was enabled here, and no synthetic probe is substituted.
